checks: Unseen notes precede the AI welcome; Escape acknowledges them without dismissing the welcome; a seen reload stays closed
Older and malformed records open; equal and future records stay closed; reading and opening never acknowledge a release
Escape, close, Got it, and backdrop persist acknowledgment; card clicks keep notes open; the saved graph and Draw board survive every route and reload

Manual toolbar access works in every mode and both themes; focus stays inside after Tab, text clicks, text selection, and outside focus attempts; closing restores the entry and shortcuts preserve the draft and undo/redo transactions
Closing the AI assistant, opening manual notes, and reopening the assistant preserves an unsent prompt; notes hide the floating AI entry
At 390 by 667, both themes keep the dialog and dismiss controls within the viewport, and the manual toolbar entry remains reachable
When reads and writes of the acknowledgment key throw SecurityError, explicit dismissal remains effective throughout the page session and manual reopening still works
Shared loading defers unseen notes without acknowledging them, completion opens them, and an acknowledged release does not interrupt presentation or its exit
A failed shared load keeps unseen notes deferred and leaves the acknowledgment absent

negativeControl.action: Click a release highlight, press Control+z, wait 600ms, and press Escape

limits: Presentation is exercised after explicit acknowledgment. Pending unseen notes during presentation need controller and App tests.
Shared responses are browser-routed fixtures. No live AI or shared backend calls are made.
The existing full AI overlay blocks toolbar clicks. Prompt preservation uses its Close control before opening notes, then reopens the assistant.
Acknowledgment is local to one browser profile and origin. When its storage is unavailable, page-session dismissal may repeat after a full reload.
